title: bullet schedule closed form
_comment: Hand-computed ground truth for the bullet structure. Inputs are pinned test vectors, exempt from band validation. Expected values are already quantized at their storage or metric boundary with ROUND_HALF_UP, exactly as the engine will publish them.
arithmetic: step 1: all_in_rate = base_rate 4.0000 + spread 4.0000 = 8.0000, scale 4 percent_annual, exact sum, no rounding needed.
step 2: payment date 1 = add_months(close 2026-03-31, 1) = 2026-04-30, day of month 31 clamped to April last day 30, 2026-04-30 is Thursday, a business day, no roll.
step 3: payment date 2 = add_months(close 2026-03-31, 2) = 2026-05-31, day 31 preserved because May has 31 days, 2026-05-31 is Sunday, roll forward to Monday 2026-06-01.
step 4: payment date 3 = add_months(close 2026-03-31, 3) = 2026-06-30, day 31 clamped to June last day 30, 2026-06-30 is Tuesday, a business day, no roll.

step 5: payment date 4 = add_months(close 2026-03-31, 4) = 2026-07-31, day 31 preserved because July has 31 days, 2026-07-31 is Friday, a business day, no roll. The four dates 2026-04-30, 2026-06-01, 2026-06-30, 2026-07-31 are strictly increasing.
step 6: period 1 spans (close 2026-03-31, payment 1 2026-04-30], days_between = 30, ACT/365 year fraction = 30/365.
step 7: period 1 interest = 0.08 x 100,000,000 cents x 30/365 = 657,534.246575342465753424657534 cents, quantize to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP once = 657,534 cents.

step 8: period 2 spans (payment 1 2026-04-30, payment 2 2026-06-01], days_between = 32, ACT/365 year fraction = 32/365, interest = 0.08 x 100,000,000 cents x 32/365 = 701,369.8630136986301369863014 cents, quantize to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP once = 701,370 cents.

step 9: period 3 spans (payment 2 2026-06-01, payment 3 2026-06-30], days_between = 29, ACT/365 year fraction = 29/365, interest = 0.08 x 100,000,000 cents x 29/365 = 635,616.4383561643835616438356 cents, quantize to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP once = 635,616 cents.

step 10: period 4 spans (payment 3 2026-06-30, payment 4 2026-07-31], days_between = 31, ACT/365 year fraction = 31/365, interest = 0.08 x 100,000,000 cents x 31/365 = 679,452.0547945205479452054794 cents, quantize to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP once = 679,452 cents.

step 11: opening balance period 1 = facility 100,000,000 cents. Principal = 0 cents in periods 1, 2, and 3, bullet repayment of 100,000,000 cents in period 4. Closing balance = opening minus principal: 100,000,000 then 100,000,000 then 100,000,000 then 0 cents.
step 12: opening balance period t equals the prior closing balance, so periods 2, 3, and 4 all open at 100,000,000 cents.
step 13: total_interest = 657,534 + 701,370 + 635,616 + 679,452 = 2,673,972 cents, exact integer sum of the quantized rows, no further rounding.
step 14: total_principal = 0 + 0 + 0 + 100,000,000 = 100,000,000 cents, exact integer sum. Row 4 closing balance 0 equals principal repaid, so the schedule ties out.
step 15: closing_fee = 1.00 percent x 100,000,000 cents = 1,000,000 cents = 10,000.00 USD, exact product, no rounding needed.

step 16: moic = (total_interest 2,673,972 + total_principal 100,000,000 + warrant value 0) / 100,000,000 = 1.02673972, quantize to scale 2 with ROUND_HALF_UP once = 1.03, closing fee excluded from the numerator.
step 17: warrant_coverage_pct 0.00 means no warrant is granted, so warrant value publishes as 0 usd_minor_units with status not_granted, never a missing field.

base_rate.source: fixture pinned rate, not a Valet observation
